I'm one of the (very few) Statistics major in the Philippines. In fact, my professor once jokingly said that we are *"endangered species"* due to the traditionally low number of 
enrollees per academic year. This has posed extra challenges during my studies since there are lesser support system who could extend their hands. Nevertheless, I have found extra resources online. I think this is helpful for you if you are also someone who:

* 1. HATES proving theorems and found applied statistics more enjoyable;
* 2. Comes from a developing nation who doesn't have all the time to learn huge books due to poor internet connection, frequent power outage, etc and;
* 3. Is frustrated because the software keeps crashing so you are considering making your own package for valid inference.

I've divided into: **Statistical Methods and Package Development**
